import Mathlib.Order.Lattice
import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.AddGroup
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Classical

theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [AddGroup G] [ConditionallyCompleteLattice G] [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → G} [AddLeftMono G] (hf : BddAbove (Set.range f)) (a : G) : a + ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, a + f i := by
  have h1 : ∀ i, a + f i ≤ a + ⨆ i, f i := by
    intro i
    rw [add_le_add_iff_left]
    exact le_supr f i

  have h2 : a + ⨆ i, f i ≤ ⨆ i, a + f i := by
    rw [le_supr]
    intro i
    exact add_le_add_left (le_supr f i) a

  have h3 : ∀ (u : G), (∀ i, a + f i ≤ u) → a + ⨆ i, f i ≤ u := by
    intros u h
    rw [le_add_iff_left]
    exact (h3' u).mpr (λ i, h i)

  have h4 : ∀ (u : G), (∀ i, a + f i ≤ u) → ⨆ i, a + f i ≤ u := by
    intros u h
    rw [le_supr]
    intro i
    exact h i

  rw [eq_iff_le_and_ge]
  exact ⟨h2, h1⟩
